body:
CANONICAL, continued: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents (Engram::Fable; rev 4, 2026-11-03 22:12Z). termal-host-workarounds is at its size limit (rev 97); read both. Each line names the item whose fix retires it.

!! NEVER `git clean -X` / `-fX` / `-fdX` (or any git clean) IN A RUNNER CLONE OR SHARED CHECKOUT, even with explicit path arguments. On 2026-11-03 at 15:00Z on Windows B it deleted the shared target/runner-inputs, target/tmp and target/p (Engram w-789a7d0e554d). Cleanup deletes only exact paths that were resolved and checked to lie inside the job's own folder, or uses `git worktree remove` for a worktree. Before any recursive delete: absolute path, prefix check, symlink check, and no live process using it.

!! NEVER RERUN ON "UNKNOWN" (P1 TermAl w-96480bbbe221, inverse of w-881c69c0ccdb): TermAl can close a check as Unknown at turn end while its launcher run is STILL RUNNING, and its notice may even say "run it again".
- Read the launcher's results.json in .git/worktrees/<root>/review-runs/<run-id>/.
- A live executor pid with a fresh heartbeat means running.
- Never rerun only for TermAl credit.

- TermAl HOST CREDIT IS NOT A LANDING CONDITION. A remote run of the standard launcher on a bundle of the exact candidate gates the landing through the integration owner's record: run id, host, commit, tree, before and after fingerprints (TermAl w-5e2f3fba987a). "input: matched" means before = after = expected. A run in a shared root that covers two items credits only one (w-db79607d5b15). Remote credit is planned through TermAl K3 w-48c4a207f226 and Engram w-f1acdb37a014.
- termal_resume_after_test_runs on a remote run returns 404 "test run is not indexed" (w-5e2f). Wait for the runner's END by mail; no polling, no rerun.
- A FAILED review attempt (for example a Claude weekly-limit refusal) reads back as 409 review_result_unvalidated (TermAl w-702471308936). Cite the author's verbatim refusal note. Claude limited means ONE Kimi stand-in (AGENTS).
- STALE WORK REVISION (TermAl w-c43760ef6a60): fixed and live since the 22:05Z restart (14b53e3b).
- SOURCE ROOT "UNCONFIRMED" (TermAl w-426dcbda4467) never blocks actions. A session waiting for "next turn" needs a continuation message.
- REMOTE RUNNERS AFTER A QUARANTINE, RESTART OR PAUSE:
  - ENDs may be delayed (409 or 503; w-c03ce2f854e8; dispatch-to-start delay w-c752e99e378b); don't rerun. A relay send that gets 409 "federation link changed": wait for re-auth, then ONE retry with the SAME idempotency key.
  - A request can sit UNREAD at a runner for hours: on 2026-11-03 Mac request 113 was saved at 16:41Z, the runner's read failed 503, 409, 423, and it never started. If no START arrives within about 15 min, ask the runner; "dispatched, outcome unobserved" is the honest state until it answers.
  - A runner may admit stale pre-quarantine requests (w-4226eb67e0f9).
  - Relay mail normally shows durableButNotWoken; that isn't a failure, so don't resend.
- DL560 session-1 and session-4 have SEPARATE mailboxes and share ONE disk. Check which lane holds a request before rerouting. Session-1 has no Chromium, Chrome or Playwright; a browser smoke needs Central.
- A TermAl-spawned Sol child on Windows can fail terminal creation through the WindowsApps pwsh alias (reported to Fable2 by Website, 2026-11-03). Workaround: a native Codex Sol worker with an explicit Windows PowerShell path.
- LAUNCHER STOP works on POSIX since 0fe6348 (w-efec landed 14:49Z). A hung run with no supported stop is ended only with the coordinator's authorization: evidence first, then SIGTERM, then SIGKILL, on individual pids that descend from the run's own executor and live in its own folders. Never killpg a foreign group; never the installed engram, a live engram mcp or control process, TermAl, or another job.
- STALE STOP AT A RUNNER: the coordinator answers with Greg's later words and their sources.
- A git bundle of the exact commit, mailed to a runner, needs no test ref (rules-remote-test-runs-2026-10-31 §2). Mac Engram runner: 6201 ONLY; 6200 idle.
- The TermAl host's PID changes at each restart (38984 since 22:05Z on 11-03). Identify it by its command line `cargo run --release`; it is Greg's, never touch it or count it as a job.
